name: New Industrial Master Plan 2030
summary: Malaysia's fourth industrial master plan (2023-2030): mission-based strategy to raise manufacturing value-added via economic complexity, technology adoption and net-zero push.

name: National Semiconductor Strategy
summary: RM500bn-investment, three-phase strategy to move Malaysia up the semiconductor value chain - IC design, advanced packaging, wafer fabrication and equipment.

name: National Energy Transition Roadmap
summary: Roadmap to net-zero by 2050 across six levers: renewables, energy efficiency, hydrogen, bioenergy, green mobility and CCUS.

name: Large Scale Solar programme
summary: Utility-scale solar PV competitive-bidding programme run by the Energy Commission that replaced feed-in-tariff allocation to drive down renewable costs.

name: Rare Earth Raw Material Export Ban
summary: Ban on exporting rare earth raw materials, announced in the 12MP mid-term review, to force domestic downstream processing and capture the full value chain.

name: National Agricommodity Policy 2021-2030
summary: 10-year policy for eight commodities (oil palm, rubber, timber, cocoa, pepper, kenaf, biomass, biofuel) built on sustainability, productivity and value generation.

name: Industry4WRD: National Policy on Industry 4.0
summary: National IR4.0 policy to transform manufacturing and related services into a smart, digitally driven industry.

name: Construction 4.0 Strategic Plan 2021-2025
summary: CIDB five-year blueprint for the construction industry's digital transformation - BIM, IBS/prefabrication and smart-factory technologies.
